Hi Samir —

Thanks for signing up and for the context — this is super helpful. I work on SDR / demo intake and I’ll coordinate a short walkthrough. A few quick qualification items so the demo and sandbox guidance are high-signal:

1) Primary flow: is the priority product search re-ranking (replace current vector-based reranker) or more the support/FAQ automation? If both, which should we focus on in the 30-minute call?
2) Do you have PII in the queries (emails, order numbers)? Any special masking requirements?
3) Expected concurrency / latency targets for production (pilot vs target production)?
4) Who will join from your side on the call (tech + PM / business)?
5) Any preferred integration — direct API to backend, middleware, or via embeddings store?

If that works, here are a couple 30-min windows next week in ET (I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm):
- Wed Apr 7, 11:00–11:30 AM ET
- Thu Apr 8, 9:00–9:30 AM ET

I’m cc’ing Ben (AE) — he’ll join to cover pricing/pooled capacity options if it’s relevant. I’ve attached a short sandbox quickstart and a demo guide so you can skim ahead.

Cheers,

We should prioritize product search re-ranking for the pilot (higher business impact) and touch on support FAQ as a follow-up.

> 2) PII
We sometimes surface customer emails and order IDs in queries; we'd prefer a workflow that avoids storing raw query logs in the vendor system during pilot.

> 3) Concurrency/latency
Pilot: tolerant of p95 < 700ms; Target: p95 < 250ms for search reranks.

> 4) Attendees
I (Head of ML) and our Lead Backend Engineer (Rhea Patel) — both technical. PM may join if demo goes well.

> 5) Integration
We plan to call an API from our backend; embeddings will be stored in our vector DB (we'd like your guidance on the best approach).

Any of the proposed times work, Wed Apr 7 at 11am ET is ideal. If that slot is still open, please lock it.
